address: 40 Phalochai Road, Nai Mueang, Mueang Ubon Ratchathani, Ubon Ratchathani, 34000, Thailand
bio: This enduring local eatery is popular for its generous portions of satisfying Vietnamese noodle soup. Thick rice noodles in a peppery broth with pork ribs and sausage are elevated by adding a soft-boiled egg and fried dough. It's open for breakfast and lunch – aim to arrive early.
